lena (prod): Quick sync — we need to scope the long-term platform roadmap for routing policies + multi-region / multi-tenant isolation. Looking for prioritized constraints from eng + sre, explicit launch criteria, and a minimal beta target for customers asking for data residency and per-tenant guarantees. Drop bullets here.

omar (arch): I suggest 3 launch lanes: 1) Shared global pool with soft-affinity; 2) Affinity slices (logical tenant isolation + sharding); 3) Dedicated/reserved pools. Each lane has different cost/latency/resilience tradeoffs.

zach (eng-runtime): +1. Runtime implications: lane 2 needs per-slice KV caches, isolated batching, and separate kernel selection paths. Expect ~15-25% perf hit vs fully shared until we tune. Need clear perf targets to judge readiness.

maya (sre): Ops/SLOs: For any beta->GA we want RTO < 60s for region failover, an error-budget policy per-lane, automated rollback hooks, and a runbook for cross-region evacuation. Also need synthetic tests for cold KV warmup.

sarah (sales): Outbound: top pilot asks are EU data residency + per-tenant throughput SLAs. Customers will sign up for beta if we can offer region-level uptime (target 99.9%) and an opt-in dedicated pool option.

lena (prod): Proposed launch criteria bullets: - median latency regression <= 10% on common prompts - p95 tail within 2x of shared baseline - documented rollout + rollback playbooks - tenant-level telemetry and cost visibility - security: KMS integration + immutable audit logs - acceptance tests for failover, egress controls, and billing reconciliation.

omar (arch): Dependencies we need to call out: network egress controls (per-tenant), region pair capacity planning, a routing DSL for affinity policies, tagging/metadata service for tenants, and billing hooks. Also policy for auto-eviction when noisy neighbors spike.

zach (eng-runtime): Implementation note: support auto-fallback to a quantized or smaller-variant model when capacity constrained. Example routing snippet for discussion: ```routes:
  - match: tenant.region == 'eu'
    policy: affinity_slice
    fallback: quantized-small```

maya (sre): Ops checklist (short): chaos testing (region down), failover latency measurement, metering validation, synthetic KV warmup, and a single-command evacuation drill. Need SRE owners per region lane.

sarah (sales): How long until a pilot-ready beta for lane 2 (affinity slices) for 2-3 customers? Need rough ETA to communicate.

omar (arch): Rough engineering estimate: MVP (lane 1 + basic affinity routing) 3-4 sprints. Full slice isolation with billing + KMS + per-tenant telemetry ~ additional 3 sprints. Contingent on infra hires and network egress work.

lena (prod): Action items: Omar -> draft spec with explicit acceptance criteria by Friday. Zach -> attach perf microbenchmarks and expected regressions. Maya -> author failover runbook draft. Sarah -> gather/confirm pilot customer list and requirements. I'll consolidate for roadmap sync Wed. @here react with :thumbsup: if aligned or drop blockers.
